headline: 473 fresh cases: Dengue infections surge overnight
summary: Health officials report a sharp increase in dengue cases and one death within a single night.
details: Health officials have reported 473 new cases of dengue fever overnight.
The surge in infections has been accompanied by one confirmed death due to the virus.
Medical facilities are monitoring the situation as the number of infections continues to rise.
Authorities urge the public to take precautions against mosquito-borne diseases to curb the spread.

headline: 16kg gold bars seized from fruit crate at Dhaka airport
summary: Customs authorities recovered the gold bars hidden in a hollow section of a wooden crate imported from Hong Kong.
details: Customs authorities seized approximately 16 kg of gold bars from a fruit crate at the Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport cargo village.
The recovery took place on Sunday afternoon near Gate 9 of the cargo village, where the gold bars were found wrapped in adhesive tape.
Acting on a tip-off, DGFI members conducted a raid in the import section of the cargo village, with Dhaka Customs officials present during the search.
The gold bars were discovered hidden in a hollow space between two pieces of wood at the bottom of the fruit crate.
The shipment of fruit had been imported from Hong Kong via a Cathay Pacific flight under the name of an organization called Foodlink.
Customs officials noted that there has been a increasing trend of gold smuggling through the airport using innovative and deceptive methods.
